resources.string: Your diecast collection, on this phone only: no account, no server. First a quick look around — it takes half a minute.
Every diecast you own, wish for or spotted lives here. Search, filter and sort; tap one to open it.
Tap + to scan a card with the AI, scan many at once, fill one in by hand, or check in a store whether you already have it.
Your collection in numbers: what it\'s worth, what\'s rarest, and your shelves in 3D.
Where and when you bought and spotted diecasts, so you know which stores are worth a visit.
Tick off the Hot Wheels and Matchbox lists year by year, or make your own list for any brand.
Language, currency, date format, the AI and your backups, all in one place.
Everything lives on this phone, so back up now and then (Settings → Data & backup). This tour is in Settings if you want it again.
To scan with the AI, add a free API key first (Gemini is the easiest).
